description: This file contains test cases for the 'live-test-helpers' module, using Vitest testing framework. It tests functions related to parsing filters, resolving configuration models, handling authentication stores, and redacting API keys.

methods.name: parseCaseFilter
methods.description: Parses case filter string into a set of strings, treating empty or 'all' as null

methods.name: parseCsvFilter
methods.description: Parses CSV filter string into a set of strings, treating empty or 'all' as null

methods.name: parseProviderModelMap
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of provider/model strings into a Map of provider to model

methods.name: redactLiveApiKey
methods.description: Redacts live API keys for diagnostics, replacing middle material with ellipsis

methods.name: resolveConfiguredLiveImageModels
methods.description: Resolves primary and fallback models into a Map for image generation

methods.name: resolveLiveImageAuthStore
methods.description: Determines the auth store configuration object based on environment conditions
